svg.title: OmniRoute monthly free-token budget: about 1.62B tokens a month steady, about 2.22B in the first month with signup credits, from 22 free pools across 465 catalog models behind one endpoint. 12 providers are ToS-flagged so you decide.
svg.desc: Stacked bar with one segment per free pool, a grid of the 22 largest pools with their monthly tokens, 9 one-time signup credit chips totalling about 601M, and notes on uncapped and identity-gated quota, which stay out of the headline.
svg.text: Each segment = one free pool · widths floored so every provider shows · honest numbers in the grid.
Pool-deduped, honest counting — no inflated rate-limit ceilings. Some terms suggest personal-use only; we flag them so you decide.
+ 15 permanently-free, no-cap providers (e.g. agnes, agnes-cn, ainative) · OpenRouter $10 → +24M/mo.
+ ~6M behind regional identity verification (modelscope) — real quota, never in the headline.
